title: tweak rule
description: One entry of a tweak import file's "configurations", and what window.tweak.createRules takes. Generated from src/@schema.

interceptionPolicy.description: MOCK answers the request itself; PATCH (Modify, premium) sends it and changes the answer; MODIFY_HEADERS rewrites headers in the browser; REDIRECT sends the request to "redirectUrl".

url.description: Matched against the request url: a substring, or a regular expression when "isRgx" is true.

isRgx.description: true reads "url" as a regular expression.

method.description: The request method to match; * matches every method.

label.description: What the rule is for, in markdown, shown on its row.

notes.description: Markdown documentation, shown in the rule's Notes tab.

status.description: The HTTP status the response carries.

requestPayload.description: The request body to match; "" matches any body.

responseHeaders.description: The response headers, one row each.

responsePayload.description: The response body, as text: JSON goes in as a string.

requestPayloadMatchPolicy.description: ANY ignores the body, EXACT wants it equal (as JSON when both parse), PARTIAL wants it contained (premium).

requestHeaders.description: A Mock reads one row: Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded matches the body as form fields.

isLogpointEnabled.description: false mutes the console group tweak prints for each interception (premium).

isEditBeforeSendEnabled.description: true pauses each matching request in the page so the user edits it by hand, then continues (premium).

editBeforeSendStage.description: Where Edit before send pauses: REQUEST (default), RESPONSE, or REQUEST_AND_RESPONSE (both).

responseHook.description: The body of a function that rewrites the response (premium). See hooks.md.

requestHook.description: The body of a function that rewrites the request (premium). See hooks.md.
